en: Why don't you start with asking her on a date? Can't go wrong with that.
A date?
Too late to get cold feet now, Leo-kun. You know what you have to do!
Or are you going to chicken out, throw away a perfectly good opportunity, and in the process, end up wasting all the work I've done?
Enough, enough! I shall text her. 'Twould be a shame, truly, to waste <Italic>your</Italic> effort.
Sarcasm aside, that's what I wanted to hear! Now, let's write that text!
Such things are beyond me, so I'm trusting you. And I'm holding you accountable if anything goes wrong.
Tell me what to text, and I shall say it.
I'm no expert, but it'll be better than leaving it up to you. So here goes...
You didn't get a response to that last text, so we'll have to do even better this time!
I'm placing my trust in you. Speak the words to unlock her heart.
Start with the subject.
Now for the first line.
Next up...
Okay, let's wrap this thing up.
And last but not least...
Okay, that should do it! Let me see what we've got here.

Are you certain this is a wise thing to do?
We'll never know until she reads it. So hit that send button already, nobleman!
Fine... Woman, I send to thee!
Beep.
Now we wait for her reply.
She is... not replying.
Hmm... That's strange.
Perhaps my text was lacking.
Now that you mention it, maybe there were some sketchy parts.
You waited until this moment to tell me!? Now what will I do?
Relax! We'll just try it again. She's bound to reply once we figure out the right thing to say!
Loath as I am to admit it, I must take your word. I have no experience in such low-class endeavors.
We'll nail it next time. Promise.
She replied!
What did she say!?
"I'd love to go out to dinner with you."
Yes! You scored big time!
You are amazing, Shinada!
Finally, the recognition I deserve!
Now, 'tis time for me to take flight and leave the proverbial nest.
Right. It's not like I can go on your date with you.
Now that that's settled, I must needs make preparations! We'll have to postpone your training for the nonce.
No worries there. You just focus on your date, buddy. Oh, and be sure to let me know how it goes!
Indeed. Let us meet at the usual place some time hence!
What the⑬!? What're you doing here, Leo-kun!?
I thought we'd made so much progress. You've totally backtracked!
Aw, come on, say something, Leo-kun. How about your girlfriend? How's she doing?
Silence!
Blah, blah, blah! Is that all you do!? This is why I despise you witless, addlepated, moronic commoner! Hmph!
Um, Leo-kun? Did something happen with your girl?
She dumped me! But that's not the worst of it!
It's not? What else happened?
Well, we were on a date...
What!? Some scary guy showed up in the middle of your date!?
That's right! He started shouting, "What are you doing with my woman!?" Then he beat the pulp out of me and robbed me blind, the larcener!
Wait a second! That's one of the oldest scams in the book! What about your new outfit?
He took everything, including my clothes and wallet. All my money's gone! It's gone, Shinada!
Wow, you literally lost the shirt off your back.
Now is not the time for japes! This is why I do not deal with your kind!
The shock's made you revert to your old ways.
Enough, Shinada! We're resuming your training presently!
I thought we were done with all that!
Silence! I said it's time for your training, and that means it is time for your training!
Once we finish this bout, your service to me is ended! You will do nothing more for me, and if you learn nothing more, so much the better!
Is that your idea of training?
You witless peasant! If I knock you senseless, I'll consider this training session a massive success!
Sheesh, he's even worse than he was before!
I'll be waiting here, Shinada. Come on back when you're ready. Then keep coming back for more.
No thanks! Well, heh, who am I kidding? I'll stop by when I have time.
That should help you relieve some that stress of yours. Besides, what happened to you is partly my fault, so...
Well said, peasant. I'm going to enjoy rearranging your face with my fists.
Heh... Hahaha!
Wow, that was delicious. And it should really help me come up with ideas for a new dish!
Let me give you some advice to thank you for telling me about such a great place.
Each dish you eat contains all sorts of ingredients⑬each one with its own unique flavor, texture, and nutritional content.
So I want you to give some thought to the ingredients being used in the food you eat even before you take your first bite.
Then you'll see how cooking is the sum of many parts. Eating is more fun when you understand the special characteristics of your food.
Pay attention to stuff like that, and you just might end up with something you didn't expect when you eat your meals.
You really should give it a try!
And that about sums it up. Did you get all that?
Got it. Cooking is the sum of many ingredients. I'll keep that in mind.
You learned <Color:9>Gourmet in Training<Color:Default>.
All right! Now that you've told me about a few great places, here's some more advanced advice for you.
Last time, I told you to think about different combinations of ingredients, but now I want you to think about the person doing the cooking.
It's a chef's skill that really allows good ingredients to shine through, but there's more to good cooking than that.
You can't just pile tasty food onto a plate. There should be a story behind it, or you should try to convey an emotion through it.
For example, people like to hear how you came up with a certain dish. Or you can try to create something that makes people smile.
You see, when people know there's more to a dish than its ingredients, they'll appreciate it that much more.
Got it. There's a story or some sort of emotion behind the food a chef makes.
You learned <Color:9>Master Gourmet<Color:Default>.
Since you've introduced me to so many great places, I'll give you the best advice I have.
You know how people say they're full but still have room for dessert?
That's because the body is quite an amazing machine. When there's something you really want to eat, it makes a little room for it.
You can say the opposite as well. The body feels full and satisfied for quite some time after eating a delicious meal.
Eating is a simple, yet joyful experience. When people think about the food and the person who made it, a meal seems more satisfying.
And when that feeling of satisfaction lasts even longer, eating becomes an even more pleasurable experience.
I want you to use all the advice I've given you to make your dining experiences more fun!
And that about sums it up. I want you to use all the advice I've given you to make your dining experiences more fun!
Use all the advice you've given me so far. Got it. I'll see what I can come up with.
You learned <Color:9>King of Gourmets<Color:Default>.
That's about all the advice I can offer. The rest is up to you. Just try different things.
Food is a very personal thing, after all, so there's a limit to how much anyone can teach someone else about it.
Anyway, now it's time for me to come up with a new dish based on all the info I gleaned from the eateries I visited.
You can now enjoy Tatsuya's new dish. He will film a show to introduce it, but it's up to you to go find where it's being served.
There's a <Color:7>food stall<Color:Default> here that can't attract a younger crowd. I'll come up with something that <Color:7>attracts customers who stop by at night<Color:Default>.
Well, you've been really helpful. Hope to see you again soon!
Thanks for all your help. Bye!
Thanks for introducing me to such a great place! It should help me come up with some good ideas.
Let me know if you find any other places I should try!

Now that you have learned Gourmet in Training, you can <Color:7>enhance abilities by eating<Color:Default>. However, the abilities you learn from Tatsuya <Color:7>only work with food served at eateries<Color:Default>. They have no effect when using food items.

You can enhance the following four abilities by eating at an eatery:

Health: <Color:7>Restores health up to the second gauge (yellow)<Color:Default>. However, the second gauge automatically falls over time.

Strength: Barehanded moves do more damage.
(Dance battle points increase in Haruka's case.)

Focus: Heat Gauge stays above a certain level.

Fighting Spirit: Heat Actions do more damage.
(Heat Gauge rises more easily in Haruka's case.)

A character's enhancement status is displayed below the Heat Gauge on the upper left part of the screen. Strength, Focus, and Fighting Spirit rise as you eat new dishes, but they are <Color:7>reset when the second Health Gauge is depleted<Color:Default>, so keep an eye on the amount left on the gauge.
You won't know what ability will rise until you eat something, but that's part of the fun. Go around town and try eating a variety of food at all sorts of eateries.
So this is the place you were talking about. Let's give it a try!
Hey, you came!
Truth be told, I wasn't really sure if you'd show up.
I'm a man of my word.
A man with a sense of duty! How cool is that? Anyway, this isn't a business meeting or anything, so let's lose the formalities.
I'm guessing you're older than me, anyway.
Right... Fine by me.
Heh, are you always this serious even when you're not working? Aw, never mind! Moving on...
If you know any other great places that serve local cuisine, please let me know!
Local cuisine?
Oh, didn't I tell you about my TV show?
I'm going to have my own spot where I prepare local dishes in various cities but put my own spin on them to help out restaurants.
The plan is to go to new eateries and those in danger of going under and have them serve my original dishes to help drum up some business.
But first, I need to go conduct some hands-on research on the tastiest local specialties.
